name: TencentDB Agent Memory (Remote)
description: Remote TencentDB Agent Memory plugin for OpenClaw — bidirectional prefetch recall & asynchronous turn sync for central TencentDB Agent Memory clusters.

coreUrl.label: MemoryCore URL
coreUrl.help: URL of the TencentDB MemoryCore (:8420) for L0-L3 hybrid retrieval

importUrl.label: MemoryPanel / Import URL
importUrl.help: URL of the TencentDB MemoryPanel (:8125) for asynchronous turn ingestion

knowledgeUrl.label: Knowledge / Wiki URL
knowledgeUrl.help: URL of the TencentDB MemoryKnowledge (:8424) for team wiki and codegraph

userKey.label: TencentDB User / Admin Key
userKey.help: Personal TencentDB API Key or Admin Key for authorization

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically sync completed conversation turns to TencentDB L0

scoreThreshold.label: Score Threshold
scoreThreshold.help: Minimum similarity score for recalled items (0.0 - 1.0). Default: 0.5

maxRecallResults.label: Max Recall Results
maxRecallResults.help: Maximum number of conversation memory snippets to prepend. Default: 3
